note: Wave C2. C1 equations with radiation as a second fluid, psi released at rest at z = 1e6, and the background CMB angle theta* = r_s(z*)/D_M(z*) with z* from the Hu-Sugiyama fit. Numbers from report() of uet_frw_cmb.py on six AI-chosen points around the T040 best fit. Approximations: massless neutrinos, GR fit for z* and the sound speed with densities inferred with today's G, no perturbations. In LambdaCDM the code gives D_M(z*) within 0.03% and r_s within 0.3% of the Planck 2018 derived values; the r_s offset comes from the z* fit, so a CMB Test Card must use one convention for model and data. Nearest theory: extended quintessence. Not UET-distinct.
